---
title: "Conference Abstracts"
format: html
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(yaml)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

abstracts <- yaml::read_yaml("data/abstracts.yml")

#Remove mentees column
abstracts <- purrr::map_dfr(abstracts, function(x) {
  x$mentees <- NULL
  x
})


# ---- Force required columns to exist ----
required_cols <- c("pdf", "link", "city", "state", "type", "award", "authors")

for (col in required_cols) {
  if (!col %in% names(abstracts)) {
    abstracts[[col]] <- NA_character_
  }
}

#Create headers for links
slugify <- function(title, meeting, year) {
  x <- paste(title, meeting, year)
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("(^-|-$)", "", x)
  x
}


abstracts <- abstracts |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date),
    slug = slugify(title, meeting, year)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(date))


badge_html <- function(scope) {
  
  if (is.na(scope)) return("")
  
  color <- switch(
    scope,
    international = "#8e44ad",
    national = "#2980b9",
    regional = "#27ae60",
    local = "#7f8c8d",
    "#bdc3c7"
  )
  
  paste0(
    "<span class='location-badge' style='background:", color, ";'>",
    toupper(scope),
    "</span>"
  )
}


```

```{r, include=FALSE}
render_section <- function(data, section_title) {
  
  
  cat("## ", section_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    cat("_No entries._\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  data <- data |> arrange(desc(date))
  
  for (yr in unique(data$year)) {
    
    cat("### ", yr, "\n\n", sep = "")
    
    subset <- data |> filter(year == yr)
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(subset))) {
      
      row <- subset[i, ]
      
      # Location
      location <- if (!is.na(row$city)) {
        paste0(row$city, ", ", row$state)
      } else {
        "Location not specified"
      }
      
         # Links: plain text when missing (kept on purpose)
         pdf_text  <- if (!is.na(row$pdf))  paste0("[File](", row$pdf, ")") else "File"
         link_text <- if (!is.na(row$link)) paste0(" | [Link](", row$link, ")") else " | Link"
         link_line <- paste0(pdf_text, link_text, "  \n")

         # Authors, with your name in bold (styled by .my-name)
         authors <- if (!is.na(row$authors)) {
           paste0(gsub("(Hemmige VS?)", "<span class='my-name'>\\1</span>", row$authors), "  \n")
         } else ""

         # Meeting and place on one line; place only if known
         where <- paste0("*", row$meeting, "*",
                         if (!is.na(row$city)) paste0(", ", row$city, ", ", row$state), "  \n")

         award_text <- if (!is.na(row$award)) paste0("**Award:** ", row$award, "  \n") else ""

         cat(
           "#### ", row$title, " ", badge_html(row$scope),
           " {#", row$slug[[1]], "}\n\n",
           authors, where, link_line, award_text, "\n",
           sep = "")    
         }
  }
}
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
render_section(
  abstracts |> filter(type == "oral"),
  "Oral Presentations"
)
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
render_section(
  abstracts |> filter(type == "poster"),
  "Poster Presentations"
)
```
